$schema_note: Generated by tools/build-species.js. [name, family, endemic] for every WCVP species placed in a family.

sources.wcvp: World Checklist of Vascular Plants (WCVP), Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew; version 16, extracted 4 June 2026; CC BY 3.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0). https://powo.science.kew.org
sources.cdfp: Island names per species: Pelser, P.B., J.F. Barcelona & D.L. Nickrent (eds.). 2011 onwards. Co's Digital Flora of the Philippines. www.philippineplants.org. Only the island names are shown; CDFP's distribution text, notes and statuses are not.
sources.gbif: Records and photos are fetched live from GBIF.org when a species is opened; each photo is credited to its creator under its own licence.
